primaryChecks.text: He said, “Go and see where he is, that I may send and get him.” He was told, “Behold, he is in Dothan.”
primaryChecks.previousContext: One of his servants said, “No, my lord, O king; but Elisha, the prophet who is in Israel, tells the king of Israel the words that you speak in your bedroom.”
primaryChecks.nextContext: Therefore he sent horses, chariots, and a great army there. They came by night and surrounded the city.
